--- title: MMS Science event subtitle: Electron-scale measurements of magnetic reconnection in space engine: julia --- On 2015-10-16 around 13:07:02 UT, MMS2 crossed an electron diffusion region (EDR) of magnetopause reconnection, the first such crossing reported by [Burch et al. (2016)](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaf2939). This tutorial rebuilds the core of their Figure 2 from burst-mode CDAWeb data: fields and moments in boundary-normal (LMN) coordinates, energy spectrograms, and the current density from the plasma moments, then zooms in on the EDR with the electron energy spectrograms parallel, perpendicular and antiparallel to B of their Figure 3. Data are read into `DataVariable`s, which keep the CDF coordinates, such as the time-varying energy bins of FPI spectra. ::: {#2 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.julia .cell-code} using CDAWeb, SPEDAS using SpaceDataModel: DataVariable using Dates, LinearAlgebra, Unitful using CairoMakie, SpacePhysicsMakie t0, t1 = DateTime("2015-10-16T13:05:30"), DateTime("2015-10-16T13:07:30") B = DataVariable(cda"MMS2_FGM_BRST_L2/mms2_fgm_b_gse_brst_l2"(t0, t1))[1:3, :] # drop |B| E = DataVariable(cda"MMS2_EDP_BRST_L2_DCE/mms2_edp_dce_gse_brst_l2"(t0, t1)) Ni, Vi, Si = DataVariable.(getdata.(cda"MMS2_FPI_BRST_L2_DIS-MOMS/mms2_dis_numberdensity_brst,mms2_dis_bulkv_gse_brst,mms2_dis_energyspectr_omni_brst", t0, t1)) Ne, Ve, Se = DataVariable.(getdata.(cda"MMS2_FPI_BRST_L2_DES-MOMS/mms2_des_numberdensity_brst,mms2_des_bulkv_gse_brst,mms2_des_energyspectr_omni_brst", t0, t1)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html} 
3-element Vector{DataVariable{Float32, N, D, A, DataVariable{CommonDataFormat.TT2000, 1, nothing, Vector{CommonDataFormat.TT2000}, Nothing, CommonDataFormat.LazyVAttrib{CommonDataFormat.CDFDataset{Int64}, Int32}}, CommonDataFormat.LazyVAttrib{CommonDataFormat.CDFDataset{Int64}, Int32}} where {N, D, A<:AbstractArray{Float32, N}}}:
 mms2_des_numberdensity_brst [Time Range: 2015-10-16T13:05:30.014031 to 2015-10-16T13:07:29.985733, Units: cm^-3, Size: (4000,)]
 mms2_des_bulkv_gse_brst [Time Range: 2015-10-16T13:05:30.014031 to 2015-10-16T13:07:29.985733, Units: km/s, Size: (3, 4000)]
 mms2_des_energyspectr_omni_brst [Time Range: 2015-10-16T13:05:30.014031 to 2015-10-16T13:07:29.985733, Units: keV/(cm^2 s sr keV), Size: (32, 4000)]
``` ::: ::: ::: ## Boundary-normal coordinates Minimum variance analysis of the magnetic field across the clean magnetopause crossing at 13:05:40 gives the LMN frame: L along the reconnecting field, N normal to the boundary. ::: {#4 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.julia .cell-code} F = mva_eigen(tview(B, DateTime("2015-10-16T13:05:40"), DateTime("2015-10-16T13:06:09"))) F.vectors # columns: L, M, N in GSE ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3×3 StaticArraysCore.SMatrix{3, 3, Float32, 9} with indices SOneTo(3)×SOneTo(3): 0.368769 0.573991 0.731125 -0.123627 -0.749286 0.650605 0.921263 -0.33031 -0.205352 ``` ::: ::: These match the axes of Burch et al.: L = (0.3665, −0.1201, 0.9226), M = (0.5694, −0.7553, −0.3245), N = (0.7358, 0.6443, −0.2084) GSE. `mva(x, F)` rotates any vector series into this frame; `setcoord` updates its coordinate metadata. ::: {#6 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.julia .cell-code} lmn(x, sym) = setmeta(setcoord(mva(x, F), "LMN"), "LABLAXIS" => sym, "LABL_PTR_1" => ["$(sym)_$c" for c in "LMN"]) B_lmn = lmn(B, "B") Vi_lmn = lmn(Vi, "Vi") E_lmn = lmn(tresample(E, Millisecond(30)), "E") # 8192 S/s is more than a 2-minute panel can show ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: ## Current density The current carried by the plasma is $\mathbf{J} = e\,n\,(\mathbf{V}_i - \mathbf{V}_e)$, evaluated at the electron cadence (30 ms) with the ion velocity (150 ms) interpolated onto it. ::: {#8 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.julia .cell-code} Ve_s, Vi_s, Ne_s = tsync(Ve, Vi, Ne) J = uconvert.(u"μA/m^2", Unitful.q .* parent(Ne_s)' .* (Vi_s .- Ve_s) .* u"cm^-3 * km/s") J_lmn = lmn(J, "J") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: ## Convection speeds The perpendicular (convection) speed is $|\mathbf{V} \times \mathbf{B}| / |\mathbf{B}|$, with B interpolated onto the velocity samples. Electrons and ions convect together where the plasma is frozen-in; their speeds separate where the ions decouple from the field. ::: {#10 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.julia .cell-code} vperp(V, sym) = setmeta(mapsamples((v, b) -> norm(v × b) / norm(b), tsync(V, B)...), "LABLAXIS" => sym) Vperp = [vperp(Vi, "|Vi⊥|"), vperp(Ve, "|Ve⊥|")] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: ## Overview ::: {#12 .cell fig-height='14' execution_count=1} ``` {.julia .cell-code} density = [setmeta(Ni, "LABLAXIS" => "Ni"), setmeta(Ne, "LABLAXIS" => "Ne")] f = tplot((B_lmn, density, Si, Se, Vi_lmn, Vperp, J_lmn, E_lmn)) tlines!(f, DateTime("2015-10-16T13:07:02.2")) f ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: From top: B_L reverses across the magnetopause at 13:05:40 and again near the EDR; magnetosheath ions (~1 keV) and electrons (~100 eV) replace the hot, tenuous magnetospheric plasma; the ion jet in −L marks the reconnection exhaust; electrons convect far faster than ions (|Ve⊥| ≫ |Vi⊥|) as the spacecraft approaches the EDR; J_M peaks at the EDR (vertical line), where E also spikes. ## Electron diffusion region Over three seconds around the EDR, B_L reverses sign, J_M and E peak, and the electron spectra parallel, perpendicular and antiparallel to B change abruptly at 13:07:02.2. ::: {#14 .cell fig-height='10' execution_count=1} ``` {.julia .cell-code} tz0, tz1 = DateTime("2015-10-16T13:07:00.5"), DateTime("2015-10-16T13:07:03.5") spectra = DataVariable.(getdata.(cda"MMS2_FPI_BRST_L2_DES-MOMS/mms2_des_energyspectr_par_brst,mms2_des_energyspectr_perp_brst,mms2_des_energyspectr_anti_brst", tz0, tz1)) f = tplot((tview(B_lmn, tz0, tz1), tview(J_lmn, tz0, tz1), lmn(tview(E, tz0, tz1), "E"), spectra...)) tlines!(f, DateTime("2015-10-16T13:07:02.2")) f ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: ## Reproducibility ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## This tutorial was built using these direct dependencies ::: {#16 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.julia .cell-code} using Pkg Pkg.status() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}
